cases.explain: Человек is the subject of сидел (sat) — subjects take the nominative.

cases.sentence: ...когда Иисус пришел на обед к одному из самых уважаемых ___.
cases.explain: Из (from among) takes the genitive; фарисеев is genitive plural — 'one of the Pharisees'.

cases.sentence: Затем Иисус сказал ___, Когда ты устраиваешь званный обед или ужин, то не приглашай своих друзей.
cases.explain: Хозяину is the indirect object of сказал (said to) → dative.

cases.sentence: Пойди скорее по ___ и переулкам города и приведи сюда бедных, коллег, слепых и хромых».
cases.explain: По (along/through) takes the dative; улицам is dative plural — 'along the streets'.

cases.sentence: Предположим, кто-то из вас хочет строить ___.
cases.explain: Башню is the direct object of строить (to build) → accusative; feminine -я nouns take -ю in the accusative.

cases.sentence: Однажды в ___, когда Иисус пришел на обед к одному из самых уважаемых фарисеев, те внимательно следили за ним.
cases.explain: В marking a point in time takes the accusative; субботу means 'on the Sabbath'.

cases.sentence: Разве он не сядет вначале и не подумает, в силах ли он с ___ в 10 тысяч человек отразить того, кто идет на него с войском в 20 тысяч?
cases.explain: С meaning 'with' (accompaniment) takes the instrumental → войском, 'with an army'.

cases.sentence: Ведь если он заложит фундамент и будет не в ___ закончить постройку, то все видящие это будут над ним смеяться.
cases.explain: В marking an abstract location/condition takes the prepositional → состоянии, 'in a state/position (to finish)'.

reading.ru: Иисус спросил учителей закона и фарисеев, «Разрешено исцелять в субботу или нет?»
reading.question: What question does Jesus ask the experts in the law and the Pharisees?
options: Whether it is lawful to heal on the Sabbath
Whether it is lawful to eat on the Sabbath
Whether taxes should be paid to Caesar
Whether the poor should be invited to feasts
reading.correct: Whether it is lawful to heal on the Sabbath
reading.explain: Jesus asks the lawyers and Pharisees, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath, or not?"

reading.ru: Если у кого-то из вас сын или вол упадет в колодец, разве вы не вытащите его немедленно, даже если это будет в субботу?
reading.question: What example does Jesus give to justify healing on the Sabbath?
options: Pulling a son or ox out of a well even on the Sabbath
Building a house on the Sabbath
reading.correct: Pulling a son or ox out of a well even on the Sabbath
reading.explain: Jesus asks whether they would not immediately pull a son or an ox out of a well, even on the Sabbath.

reading.ru: Итак, когда тебя пригласили, пойди и сядь на самое последнее место, чтобы хозяин подошел к тебе и сказал, «Друг, перейди на лучшее место».
reading.question: What does Jesus advise a guest to do at a wedding feast?
options: Take the lowest place so the host may invite him higher
reading.correct: Take the lowest place so the host may invite him higher
reading.explain: Jesus advises taking the lowest place, so the host may come and say, "Friend, move up to a better place."

reading.ru: так что каждый возвышающий себя будет унижен и принижающий себя будет возвышен».
reading.question: What principle does Jesus state about pride and humility?
options: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted
The proud will always be rewarded
Only the rich will be exalted
reading.correct: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted
reading.explain: Jesus concludes that everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

reading.ru: Когда ты устраиваешь пир, приглашай на него бедных, коллег, хромых, слепых.
reading.question: Whom does Jesus tell the host to invite to a banquet instead of friends and rich neighbors?
options: The poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind
reading.correct: The poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind
reading.explain: Jesus tells the host to invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind when hosting a feast.

reading.ru: Первый сказал «Я купил землю, и мне надо пойти и посмотреть ее. Извини меня, пожалуйста».
reading.question: What excuse does the first invited guest give for not attending the banquet?
options: He has bought land and must go see it
He has no clothes to wear
He does not like the host
reading.correct: He has bought land and must go see it
reading.explain: The first guest excuses himself, saying he has bought a field and must go see it.

reading.ru: пройди по дорогам и вдоль изгородей и уговори всех, кого встретишь, прийти на пир, чтобы дом мой был полон гостей.
reading.question: What does the master tell his servant to do after the streets and lanes are searched?
options: Go along the roads and hedges and urge people to come so the house is full
Give the food to the servants
reading.correct: Go along the roads and hedges and urge people to come so the house is full
reading.explain: The master sends the servant to the roads and hedges to compel people to come, so his house will be full.

reading.ru: Говорю вам, что из прежних приглашенных никто не попробует моего обеда.
reading.question: What does the master say about those originally invited who made excuses?
options: None of them will taste his banquet
They will be forgiven and welcomed
They will host the next banquet
reading.correct: None of them will taste his banquet
reading.explain: The master declares that none of those originally invited will taste his banquet.

reading.ru: Если кто приходит ко Мне и не возненавидит отца своего, и матери, и жены, и детей, и братьев, и сестер, а притом и самой жизни своей, тот не может быть Моим учеником.
reading.question: What does Jesus say is required to be his disciple?
options: Loving him more than one's own family and life
Giving away all money to the poor
reading.correct: Loving him more than one's own family and life
reading.explain: Jesus says whoever does not put loving him above father, mother, wife, children, siblings, and even life itself cannot be his disciple.

reading.ru: Тот, кто не несет свой крест и не идет за Мной, не может быть Моим учеником».
reading.question: What else does Jesus say is necessary to be his disciple?
options: Carrying one's own cross and following him
reading.correct: Carrying one's own cross and following him
reading.explain: Jesus says whoever does not carry his own cross and follow him cannot be his disciple.

reading.ru: Разве он не сядет вначале и не подсчитает все расходы, чтобы знать, хватит ли ему денег для завершения строительства?
reading.question: What does Jesus say a person should do before building a tower?
options: Sit down first and calculate the cost
reading.correct: Sit down first and calculate the cost
reading.explain: Jesus asks whether a person will not first sit down and count the cost to see if he can finish the tower.

reading.ru: Соль хорошая вещь, но если соль потеряет свой вкус, то что может опять сделать ее соленой?
reading.question: What does Jesus say about salt that has lost its flavor?
options: Nothing can make it salty again
It can be restored by boiling
It is used to season meat
reading.correct: Nothing can make it salty again
reading.explain: Jesus says that salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, nothing can restore its flavor.
